location: Orgrimmar, below the Cleft of Shadow
entrance: Inside the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar, at /way 53.0 48.9. The tunnel leads down to the portal.

5723.objective: Kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shamans, in the first big cave and the tunnels around it.

5728.objective: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker and report back to Thrall.
5728.note: The last step of a chain of Thrall, described above the table.

5722.objective: Find the corpse of Maur Grimtotem in the dead end beside the lava and search it for his satchel.
5722.note: It continues with Returning the Lost Satchel, back to Rahauro.

5761.objective: Kill Taragaman the Hungerer and bring his heart to Neeru Fireblade.

5725.objective: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras.
5725.note: Both drop from the Searing Blade Cultists and Warlocks in the second half of the dungeon.
